attributes.description: CQ drinks originally started as Venice Cookie Company back in 2008. As early pioneers in the Venice Beach cannabis scene, we had a lot of fun forging the way for the brands you see today. We sold our first million bottles of CQ by 2016, but it was nerve-wracking too. As the first cannabis beverage brand, our mission was create an inclusive approach to plant-based wellness. We advocated for the health freedom of cannabis patients, taking a stand for their ‘right to choose’ long before there were any rules on how to do so. We’ve always believed that the cornerstone of your wellbeing starts with the ability to decide which options work best for your body. Of course, not everyone agreed with us. We got raided multiple times and our civil rights were disregarded. We spent days in court telling our story and after 3 years, we prevailed. Throughout it all, our mission never changed. We believe that normalized, legal cannabis use makes for a better world. We make wellness tasty, relaxing and fun.

attributes.description:
STIIIZY is known as an innovative, award-winning, California-based cannabis brand. Founded in 2017 as a pioneering vape company, STIIIZY evolved into so much more. Today, STIIIZY has become one of the world's most treasured cannabis brands with its class defining retail stores and amazing cannabis products Always innovating, always inspiring, always influencing: that's us. Let's take it to new heights. #STAYSTIIIZY


BATTERIES


-BAR - A sleek, high-powered vape battery with a dual pod system for mix-and-match flexibility. Adjustable voltage and airflow keep you in control, while long battery life and portable design make it ideal for on-the-go use.

-PRO/XL - The STIIIZY Pro and XL are designed for those who want more from their device. Pro delivers precision with advanced settings and sleek control, while XL extends the experience with longer battery life and larger capacity. Together, they redefine convenience, consistency, and performance in the palm of your hand.


FLOWER


-Black and White Premium Flower - STIIIZY Black Premium Flower represents the highest tier of our craft, grown indoors under controlled conditions for consistency, structure, and refined presentation. Every bud reflects careful attention to detail and premium cultivation standards. In contrast, STIIIZY White Premium Flower embraces the sun-grown tradition, showcasing natural variations shaped by the elements. Together, they highlight two distinct expressions of the plant.

-40s Flower (Pre-rolls and Blunts Available) - STIIIZY 40s take premium flower and elevate it through infusion, delivering bold flavor and smooth burn. Available in both pre-rolls and blunts, 40s are crafted for those who appreciate detail, consistency, and quality in every draw.

-Exotics (Pre-rolls Available) - Showcasing rare genetics and standout profiles, STIIIZY Exotics bring unique aromas and character to every batch. Also available in pre-rolls for a premium, ready-to-enjoy experience.


PODS


-Original / OG: Extracted from a variety of natural flora, STIIIZY’s naturally derived terpenes offer balanced aroma and taste to deliver a consistent experience every time.

-LIVE RESIN LIQUID DIAMONDS: Crafted by melting diamonds into a liquid form to give you a dab experience in the palm of your hand.

-ALL IN ONE: Perfect for when you're on the go, our classic formula offers consistent levels of potency and purity. Available for Live Resin Liquid Diamonds (1G) and LIIIL (0.5G).


EXTRACTS


-CURATED LIVE RESIN: Our Curated Live Resin captures the true essence of the plant in extract form. The whole plant is cut and harvested then immediately flash frozen, preserving the full spectrum of cannabinoids and flavor. This process delivers the pinnacle of potency, flavor and consistency.

-LIVE ROSIN BADDER: STIIIZY’S hand-crafted solventless line of extracts starts with premium flower. We combine ice, water, and flower then gently agitate, separating the ripe trichomes. Once separated, the delicate trichomes are immediately frozen then dried. Then we sieve and sift, keeping everything cold throughout the process to ensure maximum quality and taste. At no point do we use any type of chemicals during our extraction process.

-LIVE ROSIN JAM: Beginning with fresh frozen specific genetics and only the frostiest hand-picked tops, our fine-tuned solventless extraction process produces clean, high-quality concentrate that represents the pure full flavor and sensation of each specific cannabis strain. Our Live Rosin Jam is cured for just the right time and temperature, ensuring consistent quality to bring out the natural terpene and flavor profile.

-LIVE RESIN DIAMONDS: Our Live Resin Diamonds are curated specifically for usability, you will find right-sized diamond crystals suspended in our terpene packed sauce. Some Cannabis strains lend themselves particularly well to diamond creation, like they were intended for it. We let Mother Nature tell us which strains and batches are best suited for our Live Resin Diamonds.

-CRUSHED DIAMONDS: Unveil a supreme smoking experience with STIIIZY groundbreaking Crushed Diamond Extracts. Expertly curated, this high-potency extract provides the flexibility to pack, roll, or dab, empowering you to fine-tune your cannabis journey.

 

EDIBLES


-100MG: Introducing our new line of STIIIZY edibles: Original, Sour, Lemonade, Tropical. Enjoy the blend of both delicious and mouth watering flavors in every bite. 200MG available only in Michigan.

-SLEEP Edibles: STIIIZY continues our commitment to innovation and wellness with our 2:1 THC to CBN Gummy line. These delectable edibles blend THC with the relaxing powers of cannabinol (CBN).
